metadata.aioe_reference: Felten, Raj and Seamans (2021), Appendix A
metadata.population: Original 73-occupation sample; strict model includes 62 one-to-one comparable occupations

units.ep_employment_2025_thousands: Employment Projections jobs in thousands; broader coverage than OEWS
units.annual_openings_thousands: Projected annual average openings in thousands
units.projected_change_percent_2025_2035: Percent over whole decade, not annual and not AI-caused

limitations: Historical classification correspondence does not guarantee unchanged tasks.
No imputation or copying one aggregate outcome into multiple observations.
Education is typical entry requirement, not individual educational attainment.
Projected growth is not observed growth or an AI impact estimate.

occupations.exclusion_reason: One-to-many split. Could aggregate employment and employment-weighted mean wages at the old category level; medians cannot be averaged.
One-to-many split across physician specialties. Do not treat descendants as independent observations with an identical old AIOE score.

occupations.occupation_title: Health Diagnosing and Treating Practitioners, All Other
occupations.exclusion_reason: Split into acupuncturists and other practitioners.
OEWS publishes a combined laboratory technologists and technicians outcome; distinct AIOE scores cannot share that outcome as independent observations.
Same published laboratory aggregate as 29-2011; requires a justified exposure aggregation method.
Split into EMTs and paramedics; aggregate or model separately only with an explicit exposure assumption.
Merged into a redefined residual category; no isolated outcome.

occupations.occupation_title: Licensed Practical and Licensed Vocational Nurses
occupations.bls_title: Licensed Practical and Licensed Vocational Nurses

occupations.occupation_title: Medical Records and Health Information Technicians
occupations.exclusion_reason: Split; health-information technologists also receive workers from old 29-9099. Not a clean one-to-many mapping.

occupations.occupation_title: Health Technologists and Technicians, All Other
occupations.exclusion_reason: Code persists but scope changes: medical dosimetrists split out and respiratory therapy technicians enter the remaining category.

occupations.occupation_title: Healthcare Practitioners and Technical Workers, All Other
occupations.exclusion_reason: Code persists but workers split into health-information technologists and surgical assistants.
SOC recode is one-to-one, but OEWS publishes home health aides with personal care aides. An AIOE value for home health aides alone cannot represent the combined group.
